name: Moj (ShareChat / Mohalla Tech)
tagline: Indian vernacular short-video app, pivoting to micro-dramas
facts: Moj launched Jun 2020 after TikTok ban; parent 2015
Mohalla Tech (private); IPO up to $400M planned
FY25 adj. EBITDA loss ₹219 cr (-72% YoY)

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Give Bharat's next billion a social platform in their own language.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Be India's vernacular entertainment layer: short video, live and micro-dramas for tier-2+ audiences.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Pivot from chasing Reels on scale to owning profitable niches: micro-dramas, live gifting, regional creators.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: 15+ Indian languages, regional creator network, low-cost AI content production, Bharat user insight.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Micro-dramas: 65M monthly viewers, 700M episodes daily, QuickTV paywall, ₹100 cr AI content push.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Moj won the TikTok-ban land grab then lost to Reels and Shorts; was retreat to niches inevitable?

customers.pain: English-heavy apps, want entertainment in own language
customers.why: Regional language feeds, local creators, micro-dramas, works on low-end phones

customers.pain: Hard to stand out on Instagram or YouTube
customers.why: Less competition, language communities, live gifting income, creator fund
Vernacular targeting, cheaper CPMs than Meta, influencer brand integrations

customers.who: Binge viewers of serialised short dramas
customers.pain: Want cliffhanger stories in Hindi and regional languages
customers.why: QuickTV episodic paywall, cheap coin packs, TV-actor led stories

customers.pain: Want recognition and interaction with creators
customers.why: Virtual gifts in audio and video chatrooms

products.name: Moj
products.desc: Vernacular short-video feed, merged with MX TakaTak

products.name: ShareChat
products.desc: Regional-language social feed of posts, memes and video

products.name: Live and chatrooms
products.desc: Audio/video live rooms monetised through virtual gifts

portfolio.north_star: Daily time spent per active user in vernacular feeds
portfolio.key_metrics: MAU, DAU/MAU, minutes per user, creator uploads, gifting ARPPU
portfolio.guardrails: Content moderation incidents, adult content, creator churn to Reels

products.name: AI content studio
products.desc: AI tools to produce dramas cheaply at scale

portfolio.north_star: Episodes completed per viewer per week
portfolio.key_metrics: Paid conversion, episodes/day, cost per episode, series completion
portfolio.guardrails: Payback period per show, refund rate, content quality complaints

products.name: Moj/ShareChat Ads
products.desc: Self-serve and direct video ads for brands

products.name: Virtual gifting
products.desc: Coins and gifts in live rooms

portfolio.key_metrics: Ad revenue, CPM, gifting revenue, subscription ARPU
portfolio.guardrails: Ad load per session, payment failures, fraud

rows.who_uses: Free users of Moj and ShareChat
rows.how: In-feed video ads, brand challenges, influencer integrations
Platform keeps share of gifts sent to hosts
Free first episodes, then paywall or coins
Ads between episodes; funnel to paid QuickTV

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: FY25 mostly ads plus gifting; micro-drama subscriptions now driving 30%+ growth in 2026.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: ~150M MAU but only ~3M QuickTV subscribers; low Bharat ARPU forces ad-heavy model.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Losses cut 72% via layoffs and cost controls, not ad growth; cash-flow positive core business.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: AI-made micro-dramas, regional languages, paid conversion, IPO capital, brand-funded drama series.

bullets.label: Lesson
bullets.text: TikTok-ban windfall was rented demand; once Reels and Shorts arrived, scale without moat collapsed.

friction: Feed full of repetitive, low-quality reposted clips
Top creators migrated to Reels and Shorts
Heavy ad load on low-end devices
App bloat and battery drain on budget phones

competitors.label: Micro-dramas
competitors.text: Kuku TV, Pocket FM, Stage, ReelShort

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Deep vernacular data and ~65M micro-drama viewers, two-thirds of Indian format

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Meta/Google ad dominance, IT Rules moderation burden, micro-drama copycats
